caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden architectural detail featuring the head of a dog. The dog’s head is rendered in a three-dimensional, sculptural manner, protruding from a rectangular wooden panel. The dog is shown with its mouth slightly open, tongue visible, and eyes either closed or not detailed. It appears to be wearing a collar with a rectangular buckle. The fur around its neck is also carefully carved with pointed tufts. The wood is rendered in varying shades of brown, showing the grain and texture, with highlights and shadows indicating the form and depth of the carving. The background consists of angular and curved sections of wooden panels, with distinct lines indicating the joints and orientation of the wood. The entire image is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Mantle Carving (Dog's Head)
